flags.intent: Enable warm-start persistence of the daemon graph cache (ADR-069 sealed-DTO snapshots)
flags.description: Default-off (ADR-069 §7); the unset default is byte-for-byte today's rebuild-on-restart behaviour. Operator opt-in via ANVIL_PERSIST_GRAPH; graduation to default-on is gated on the §7 criteria (privacy/round-trip soak, zero Corrupt events, write-latency SLO, owner sign-off).

flags.intent: Gate /anvil docs access for authenticated beta users
Opt in to source-text snippet egress on GCTX tools (CE-1 / CE-9)
flags.description: Default-off (PV-9 CE-1): identity-only graph context is always on; source-text snippets ride only when this flag is enabled AND the request asserts include_source. Operator opt-in via ANVIL_GCTX_EGRESS=1; ANVIL_GCTX_EGRESS=0 is the kill-switch that disables all GCTX egress.

flags.intent: Save-time reverse-impact closure hop depth (env ANVIL_REVERSE_IMPACT_DEPTH): 1 hop by default, hard-capped at 2; an over-cap setting is clamped, not honoured (ADR-063 §3)
flags.description: Runtime lever for the daemon save-time certify reverse-impact depth. Default 1 hop (the ADR-061 §6 certifiability closure); the latency-coverage trade can move 1 to 2 hops without re-coding via the ANVIL_REVERSE_IMPACT_DEPTH env var. Hard-capped at MAX_REVERSE_IMPACT_DEPTH (2): an over-cap value is clamped, not honoured.

flags.intent: Umbrella gate for Track 4 semantic packs (per-pack overrides use track.pack.<pack>)
flags.description: Per-track flag taxonomy (OPSUP-005). Disables noisy Track 4 packs without rolling back the release. Ships opt-in for one release, then the default flips on; per-pack leaf overrides (e.g. track.pack.pulumi) are added by the owning pack module and inherit this umbrella.

flags.intent: Umbrella gate for Track 3 governance surfaces (per-surface overrides use track.surface.<surface>)
flags.description: Per-track flag taxonomy (OPSUP-005). Gates Track 3 governance surfaces; per-surface leaf overrides (e.g. track.surface.sql) inherit this umbrella. Graduated to default-on after the v0.8.1-beta clean release, now that all Track 3 surfaces (SQL/GHA/Dockerfile/shell) validate at <1% FP (plans/reviews/2026-06-18-surface-validation.md).

flags.intent: Gate the Dockerfile governance surface (SURFDOCK) in the gate run
flags.description: Per-surface leaf flag under the track.surface umbrella (OPSUP-005). Graduated to default-on after the v0.8.1-beta clean release (SURFDOCK-006 validation PASS on a real external Dockerfile corpus). ANVIL_TRACK_SURFACE_DOCK=0 forces it off for a session via a local override routed through the resolver; =1 forces on.
